question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guides went 7.7 -> 8.5 -> 9.2 (Q1-Q3 FY27), with actuals 7.62 and 8.41, about 9-10% per quarter. Management guided full-year FY27 opex growth in the 'low 50s' on a 23.08B FY26 base, which implies Q4 of about 9.4-10.3B. Q4 FY27 is a 14-week quarter (53-week year), which pushes the trend estimate to about 10.3-10.7B. In FY26 the Q4 guide landed at the top of the full-year growth range, and the full-year guide has been raised before. Median about 10.2B, skewed slightly up. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.

- Q1 FY27 press release (2026-05-20): Q2 outlook GAAP opex ~$8.5B / non-GAAP ~$8.3B; Q1 actual GAAP $7,621M, non-GAAP $7,449M.
- Q4 FY26 press release (2026-02-25): Q1 FY27 outlook GAAP ~$7.7B (incl. $1.9B SBC); FY26 GAAP opex $23,076M; Q4 FY26 GAAP opex $6,794M.
- Q2 FY27 call (2026-08-26): 'For full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s driven by a broadening of our product portfolio and further increase in the usage of AI tools.' Q2 GAAP/non-GAAP opex +10%/+11% QoQ, driven by compute infrastructure and compensation.
- Arithmetic: FY26 GAAP 23.08B x 1.50-1.54 = 34.6-35.5B; Q1+Q2 actual + Q3 guide = 25.23B -> Q4 implied ~9.4-10.3B.
- NVIDIA 10-Q (Jul 2026): FY2027 is a 53-week year; Q4 FY27 is a 14-week quarter (+~7.7% days vs 13-week).
- History: in FY26 the full-year growth guide was 'high 30s'; Q4 FY26 guide 6.7B made the full year ~40% (top of range). Guide-to-prior-actual steps: Q2 FY27 +0.88B, Q3 FY27 +0.79B; Q4 FY26 guide 6.7 vs Q3 FY26 actual 5.84 (+0.86B, ~15%).
- Actuals came in slightly below guide (Q1 -0.08B, Q2 -0.09B).
- Previews (Nov 2026): revenue consensus ~$109B vs $108B guide; management flagged gross margin bottoming 71-72% in the January quarter on memory costs; nothing found on opex expectations.
- Status quo: NVIDIA has given a single 'approximately' GAAP opex figure every quarter.

calls.reconciliation: Factual: (1) Run 2 said no full-year opex guidance was given; Runs 1 and 3 independently cite 'low 50s' (raised from 'high 40s'). I accept the guidance as real. (2) 14-week Q4: only Run 1 raised it. The calendar confirms it: FY26 ended Jan 25, 2026, so a last-Sunday-of-January year-end puts FY27 at Jan 31, 2027 (53 weeks, as in FY2021). Judgment: the size of the Q4 step. The full-year arithmetic centres near 9.95B and the trend plus extra week near 10.3B. I take 10.15B, leaning up because of the earlier upward revision and the FY26 precedent. No web access this run.
